description: One hooks module (orchestra.ts): injects the routing protocol at session start and a per-prompt reminder; asks the main thread to re-route once a turn hand-edits enforcement.turn_edits files; guards worker subagents against destructive VCS and the shared git stash (enforcement.worker_vcs), against writing the main working tree while they own a worktree (enforcement.worker_tree), and against a second writer in a leased worktree (enforcement.worktree_lease); nudges once per session against Opus/Fable generalist subagents (enforcement.opus_generalist) and, opt-in, direct Haiku spawns (enforcement.light_class); removes the session's clean orchestra worktrees at SessionEnd (enforcement.session_cleanup); and shows running orchestra agents in the status line (userConfig hud). Every guard has escape hatches and fails open
